answer: Ephemeral challenge slots. Each round a public randomness beacon assigns arriving identities to a zephyr slot; identities unable to answer a slot-bound challenge within the window are dropped, so mass registration gains nothing. A lucky draw into a scarce oasis window requires the attacker to hold live, responsive infrastructure per identity, since the beacon output is unknown before commit. Winning claims lock value in a vault until the next unpredictable round proves liveness, making each surviving fake identity cost real compute plus idle capital.
